name: env
title: Server env
description: Zod-validated getServerEnv() (DATABASE_URL, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, BETTER_AUTH_URL plus optional DATABASE_POOL_SIZE and DB_*_MS / DB_APPLICATION_NAME). Secrets are Secret values that print as [redacted] in strings, JSON and console output; read them with .reveal(). Validation errors name the key, never the value. Parsed on first use, so vite build needs no secrets.
